1100.d: without profit, worthlessness; by extension, destruction, wickedness
1100.o: from H1097 (בְּלִי) and H3276 (יַעַל);(often in connection with H376 (אִישׁ), H802 (אִשָּׁה), H1121 (בֵּן), etc.)

1101.d: to overflow (specifically with oil.); by implication, to mix; to fodder
1101.k: anoint, confound, [idiom] fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.
1101.o: a primitive root; (also  denominatively from H1098 (בְּלִיל)) to fodder

1103.d: to pinch sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them)

1104.d: to make away with (specifically by swallowing); generally, to destroy
1104.k: cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

1105.k: devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.

1106.d: Bela, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites

1107.o: or בַּלְעֲדֵי; constructive plural from H1077 (בַּל) and H5703 (עַד), not till, i.e. (as preposition or adverb)

1108.d: a Belaite (collectively) or descendants of Bela

1109.d: Bilam, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine
1109.o: probably from H1077 (בַּל) and H5971 (עַם); not (of the) people, i.e. foreigner;

1112.o: or בֵּלְאשַׁצַּרlemma בֵּלְאשַׁצּר missing vowel, corrected to בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר; of foreign origin (compare H1095 (בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר));

1115.d: properly, a failure of, i.e. (used only as a negative particle, usually with a prepositional prefix) not, except, without, unless, besides, because not, until, etc.
1115.k: because un(satiable), beside, but, [phrase] continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.
1115.o: constructive feminine of H1086 (בָּלָה) (equivalent to H1097 (בְּלִי));

1116.o: from an unused root (meaning to be high);

1118.o: probably from H4107 (מָהַל) with prepositional prefix; with pruning;

1120.d: Bamoth or Bamoth-Baal, a place East of the Jordan
1120.o: plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); heights; or (fully) בָּמוֹת בַּעַל; from the same and H1168 (בַּעַל); heights of Baal;

1121.d: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
1121.k: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

1123.d: {a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense}

1125.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H40 (אֲבִימֶלֶךְ); (the) son of Abinadab;

1126.d: Ben-Oni, the original name of Benjamin
1126.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H205 (אָוֶן); son of my sorrow;

1127.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1397 (גֶּבֶר); son of (the) hero;

1128.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and a derivative of H1856 (דָּקַר); son of piercing (or of a lance);

1129.k: (begin to) build(-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), [idiom] surely.

1130.d: Ben-Hadad, the name of several Syrian kings
1130.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H1908 (הֲדַד); son of Hadad;

1132.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2105 (זוֹחֵת); son of Zocheth;

1133.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2354 (חוּר); son of Chur;

1134.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2428 (חַיִל); son of might;

1135.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2605 (חָנָן); son of Chanan;

1136.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H2617 (חֵסֵד); son of kindness;

1137.d: Bani, the name of five Israelites

1139.d: sons of lightning, Bene-berak, a place in Palestine
1139.o: from the plural construction of H1121 (בֵּן) and H1300 (בָּרָק);

1141.d: Benajah, the name of twelve Israelites
1141.o: or בּנָיָהוּ; (prolonged) from H1129 (בָּנָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah has built;

1142.d: Bene-Jaakan, a place in the Desert
1142.o: from the plural of H1121 (בֵּן) and H3292 (יַעֲקָן); sons of Yaakan;

1143.d: a double interval, i.e. the space between two armies

1144.d: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory
1144.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H3225 (יָמִין); son of (the) right hand;

1145.d: a Benjaminite, or descendent of Benjamin
1145.o: sometimes (with the article inserted) בֵּן־הַיּמִינִי; with H376 (אִישׁ) inserted (1 Samuel 9:1) בֶּן־אִישׁ ימִינִי; son of a man of Jemini; or shortened אִישׁ יְמִינִי; (1 Samuel 9:4; Esther 2:5) a man of Jemini, or (1 Samuel 20:1) simply יְמִינִיxlit Yᵉmînîy corrected to Yᵉmîynîy; a Jeminite; (plural) בְּנֵי יְמִינִיxlit Bᵉnîy corrected to Bᵉnêy; patron from H1144 (בִּנְיָמִין);

1148.o: probably from H1121 (בֵּן) with pron. suff.; our son;

1151.o: from H1121 (בֵּן) and H5971 (עַם) with pronomial suffix; son of my people;

1152.o: from H5475 (סוֹד) and H3050 (יָהּ) with prepositional prefix; in (the) counsel of Jehovah;

1154.o: from an unused root meaning to be sour;

1156.k: ask, desire, make (petition), pray, request, seek.

1157.d: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
1157.k: about, at by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

1158.d: to gush over, i.e. to swell; (figuratively) to desire earnestly; by implication to ask
1158.k: cause, inquire, seek up, swell out.

1160.d: Beor, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam
1160.o: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of burning); a lamp;

1162.d: Boaz, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple
1162.o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning;

1165.o: from H1197 (בָּעַר) (in the sense of eating);

1166.d: to be master; hence, to marry
1166.k: have dominion (over), be husband, marry(-ried, [idiom] wife).
1166.o: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1167 (בַּעַל)

1167.d: a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense)
1167.k: [phrase] archer, [phrase] babbler, [phrase] bird, captain, chief man, [phrase] confederate, [phrase] have to do, [phrase] dreamer, those to whom it is due, [phrase] furious, those that are given to it, great, [phrase] hairy, he that hath it, have, [phrase] horseman, husband, lord, man, [phrase] married, master, person, [phrase] sworn, they of.

1170.d: Baal-Berith, a special deity of the Shechemites
1170.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1285 (בְּרִית); Baal of (the) covenant;

1171.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H1409 (גָּד); Baal of Fortune;

1173.d: Baalah, the name of three places in Palestine

1174.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H1995 (הָמוֹן); possessor of a multitude;

1175.k: Bealoth, in Aloth (by mistake for a plural from H5927 (עָלָה) with prepositional prefix).

1176.d: Baal-Zebub, a special deity of the Ekronites
1176.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H2070 (זְבוּב); Baal of (the) Fly;

1177.d: Baal-Chanan, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite
1177.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2603 (חָנַן); possessor of grace;

1178.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and a modification of H2691 (חָצֵר); possessor of a village;

1179.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H2768 (חֶרְמוֹן); possessor of Hermon;

1180.d: Baali, a symbolical name for Jehovah
1180.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) with pron. suff.; my master;

1181.d: Baale-Bamoth, a place East of the Jordan
1181.o: from the plural of H1168 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H1116 (בָּמָה); Baals of (the) heights;

1182.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H3045 (יָדַע); Baal has known;

1183.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3050 (יָהּ); Jah (is) master;

1184.o: from the plural of H1167 (בַּעַל) and H3063 (יְהוּדָה); masters of Judah;

1185.o: probably from a derivative of H5965 (עָלַס) with prepositional prefix; in exultation;

1186.d: Baal-Meon, a place East of the Jordan
1186.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H4583 (מָעוֹן); Baal of (the) habitation (of) (compare H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן));

1187.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6465 (פְּעוֹר); Baal of Peor;

1188.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and the plural of H6556 (פֶּרֶץ); possessor of breaches;

1189.o: from H1168 (בַּעַל) and H6828 (צָפוֹן) (in the sense of cold) (according to others an Egyptian form of Typhon, the destroyer); Baal of winter;

1190.d: Baal of Shalishah, Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine

1192.o: from H1172 (בַּעֲלָה) and H875 (בְּאֵר); mistress of a well;

1193.o: from H1167 (בַּעַל) and H8558 (תָּמָר); possessor of (the) palm-tree;

1194.d: Beon, a place East of the Jordan
1194.o: probably a contraction of H1010 (בֵּית בַּעַל מְעוֹן);

1195.d: Banana, the name of four Israelite

1196.d: Baanah, the name of four Israelites
1196.o: from a derivative of H6031 (עָנָה) with prepositional prefix; in affliction

1197.d: to kindle, i.e. consume (by fire or by eating);  to be(-come) brutish
1197.k: be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (on fire), waste.
1197.o: a primitive root; also as denominative from H1198 (בַּעַר)

1198.d: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness; (concretely) stupid
